contract: Exact complete outputs, supported behavior, errors and all upstream tests.
editable: Production C and headers under src/liblzma; retain upstream tests.
families: Complete unchanged source files from independent public projects.
Complete unchanged single-block upstream .tar.xz release archives, decoded in full.
Correctness-only CRC64-rejection and concatenated-stream inputs derived from public source files.
job: Compress independent unchanged source files using one fresh preset-6 library call per file, and stream-decode complete upstream .tar.xz release archives with one fresh decoder per archive.
limits: Source-file compression is not all binary data or all liblzma configurations.
name: XZ liblzma
operations: lzma_stream_decoder(UINT64_MAX, LZMA_CONCATENATED) with chunked lzma_code (64 KiB in/out, LZMA_RUN then LZMA_FINISH)
options: Preset 6; CRC64; fresh per-input context; no persistent state. Decode: no memory limit, concatenated streams, integrity checks verified.
outputs: One complete XZ stream per input, with pinned byte length and SHA-256. Decode: decoded byte count plus XXH64 of every decoded byte, or the exact error.
preparation: Use the pinned source and offline worker; build into a fresh directory.
size_meaning: Original complete-file byte length and structure.
title: Compress source files and decode release archives with XZ Utils
heldout_readme_text: Held-out release archives are fetch-only; verification acquires and authenticates them outside the repository. The other held-out input bodies and all held-out expected outputs are stored with Git LFS and authenticated at scoring.
